intent: Record as reviewed the feedback, funnel, retention, disclosure and visit rules the analytics Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context analytics lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A reported build id is kept only when it is non-blank and at most 64 bytes; otherwise it is dropped and the report is still accepted.
A feedback report that names a run is refused with a server error when the run ownership reader is not wired, and nothing is stored.
The daily funnel counts downloads as distinct Workspaces and every other stage as distinct sessions.
Maintenance deletes analytics events strictly older than the retention window; an event exactly at the cutoff is kept.
Purging feedback removes only reports created before the retention window, and the preview counts exactly what the purge removes.
A search query is recorded only by its script bucket, with Han, Hiragana, Katakana and Hangul all bucketed as han; the text itself is never stored.
The public retention disclosure reports whole days rounded up, so a window under a day reads as one day, never zero.
When no feedback retention window is set, the disclosure shows no day count and says reports are kept until one is set, never zero days.
A visit starts, and its cookie is reissued, only when the request has no visit cookie or one dated before today in UTC.
Partition maintenance without a positive retention window is refused and deletes no analytics events, since a zero window would delete everything.
The feedback message limit counts characters, not bytes, so 2000 Chinese characters are accepted.
A feedback request body over 8 KiB is refused before any field is read.
